title: Mental Poker
tagline: Decentralized poker for 3 players with a new frontend for evm wallets.
description: The project was started in EthGlobal Trifecta. A new web frontend was added in Tokyo. The frontend lets players connect with a shield or ethereum wallet. ENS lets players join by name and see the names in the frontend. Signing in with ethereum creates a temporary aleo wallet that automatically signs transactions without decisions for more speed (shuffle, decrypt, showdown, claim)
how_its_made:
Next.js frontend on top of mental poker on Aleo. Proofs go through Provable’s delegated prover.

ETH path is viem + ENSv2 on Sepolia (poker.game, poker.tables, network.aleo). Temp Aleo key lives in the browser; /api/fund pays the house credits in and takes leftovers back. Shield uses the Aleo wallet adapter. Same game controller for both.
auto_summary: A Rust and Leo mental poker project for Aleo with on-chain program bindings and terminal-based game binaries.
